name: Empower Script (Metascript)
body:
You can increase the power of your scripts, causing them to deal more damage.

Prerequisite: Caster level 5th

Benefit: All variable, numeric effects of an empowered script are increased by half including bonuses to those dice rolls.

Saving throws and opposed rolls are not affected, nor are scripts without random variables.

You may empower a script once per day, plus an additional time per day at 10th and 15th caster level. The script must be at least one level lower than the highest level of script you can cast.
